guide: Use an AI assistant to interview you into a clear set of requirements before it builds anything. You need ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code, and a rough idea of what you want to end up with.
1. Write the end goal in one or two sentences: what the finished thing does and who uses it.
1. Open ChatGPT (Codex) or Claude Code and ask it to interview you, one question at a time, working backwards from that goal.
1. Answer its questions about the architecture: what the pieces are, what talks to what, and in what order.
1. Ask it to question you on the cloud platform too (AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure) and why that one fits.
1. Say "I don't know" when you are unsure and ask it to explain the options in plain English, so you understand the structure.
1. Ask it to write everything up as one requirements document, then read it and correct anything wrong.
1. Start a fresh chat or session, paste in the finished requirements and ask the assistant to build from them.
Watch out: if you let the AI decide everything without understanding the structure, you cannot diagnose problems later, so only accept answers you can explain back.
